first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links signup simplification and shorter onboarding to durable activation and adoption gains. Verify both closely related records before testing a guarded simplification, while monitoring lead quality and downstream qualified revenue so faster completion does not reduce account quality.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment for SMB and simple-workspace accounts only. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because shortened onboarding increased their 60-day churn by 9%. The signup-simplification evidence shows a durable activation lift and positive qualified-revenue impact, while onboarding completion is currently declining. Monitor activation, completion, qualified revenue, and retention before expanding.
